decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed extensions by reason of their coverage and cramped appearance would not be in keeping with the form, character, and style of surrounding development and provide inadequate garden space.  This represents an over development of the site which would be harmful to the appearance of the area and harmful to the living conditions of the existing and future occupiers of the house.  This would be contrary to policies B.1.1 (New Development), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), and Supplementary Guidance for Private Garden Space of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - The two storey side extension due to its size, scale, and appearance, would not be in keeping with the character and style of the existing house and surrounding properties and woudl unbalance the appearance of this pair of semi-detached houses.  This would be harmful to the appearance of the area contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), and supplementary guidance for Residential Extension Guidelines, of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
description: Demolition of existing garage and the erection of a two storey side and single storey rear to house
